content:
🔴 आज है आवेदन की अंतिम तिथि – 27 July 2026

Indian Overseas Bank IOB Apprentice Online Form 2026 – Link Active | आज Last Date

  • Last Date : 27 July 2026 (आज) – Extended
  • Total : 750 Posts
  • Status : Link Active – आज ही Apply करें
  • Exam Date : 02 August 2026 (tentative as notified)

Indian Overseas Bank (IOB) has invited online applications for engagement of 750 Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961 for FY 2026-27.

जो अभी तक फॉर्म नहीं भरा – आज अंतिम मौका है (आवेदन 27 July तक; fee payment 28 July तक extended notice के अनुसार)।

Important Dates

  • Application Begin : 07 July 2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online : 27 July 2026 (आज – Extended)
  • Pay Fee Last Date : 28 July 2026 (as per extension notice)
  • Online Exam Date : 02 August 2026
  • Admit Card : Before exam

Application Fee (indicative – verify on portal)

  • General / OBC / EWS (Male) : about ₹944
  • General / OBC / EWS (Female) : about ₹708
  • SC / ST / PH : about ₹236

Eligibility

Graduation from recognized university; age generally 20–28 years as on 01.07.2026 with category relaxations. State-wise seats and language rules as per official PDF.

Selection Process

Online Test → Local Language Test → Document Verification → Apprenticeship engagement (stipend as per bank rules).

How to Apply (अभी करें)

  1. Open IOB Careers – iob.bank.in / iob.in
  2. Read Apprentice 2026-27 notification + extension notice
  3. Apply through NAPS / NATS / BEEP as directed
  4. Fill form, pay fee, submit before deadline
  5. Keep print / screenshot of confirmation

Apply only on official IOB / BFSI-SSC portals. Last date today – delay mat karo.
